name: Error Boundary
description: A class-based error boundary that isolates render failures behind a fallback UI with reset support.
usage:
<ErrorBoundary
  fallback={(error, reset) => <Fallback error={error} onRetry={reset} />}
  onError={(error, info) => log(error)}
  resetKeys={[pageId]}
>
  <Report />
</ErrorBoundary>

anatomy.description: Class component that catches render errors from its subtree and reports them through onError.
Node or render prop receiving (error, reset) that is shown while the subtree is failed.
Re-renders the children when reset() is called or any resetKey changes.

dos: Place boundaries around independently failing subtrees such as widgets or third-party embeds.
Give the fallback a recovery path through the reset callback.
donts: Don't catch expected async errors here; handle those in data-loading code with EmptyState or Alert.
Don't wrap the entire app in one boundary; a single failure then blanks the whole page.

examples.title: Recoverable fallback
examples.description: A render-prop fallback that shows the error and offers a retry via the reset callback.

examples.title: Static fallback
examples.description: A plain React node shown whenever the protected subtree throws.

guidance.useWhen: A subtree can fail independently — dashboards, widgets, or third-party embeds — and the rest of the page must survive.
guidance.avoidWhen: Handling expected async errors; catch those in data-loading code and show EmptyState or Alert instead.
guidance.behavior: Catches render errors below it, calls onError, swaps in the fallback, and re-renders children on reset() or when any resetKey changes.
guidance.responsive: Layout-agnostic; the fallback owns its own sizing.

notes: Give the fallback an accessible error message, for example role="alert", so the failure is announced.
Provide a keyboard-reachable recovery action such as a retry button.

props.description: Rendered instead of children when an error is caught. As a function it receives the error and a reset callback.
props.name: fallback

props.description: Called with the error and component stack when an error is caught.
props.name: onError

props.description: Resets the boundary whenever any of these values change.
props.name: resetKeys
